user_stories.story: As a player, I want to click Karma and see her connected abilities, effects, builds, runes, and items so I understand why a build is recommended.
acceptance: Abilities and effects appear by group
Edges show source status and confidence

user_stories.story: As a coach, I want to compare two assets, such as Inspire and Aery, so I can explain the synergy.
As a data auditor, I want to hide generated rules so I only inspect source-verified or corrected relationships.
As the app builder, I want saved graph views for common coaching questions so users do not start from a blank canvas.
acceptance: Views include center node, filters, depth, layout

user_stories.story: As a beginner, I want relationship labels in plain English so graph lines are not confusing.
